setup: Same-side knee and hand on a flat bench
Hand under shoulder, knee under hip
Other foot on the floor, back flat
Let the arm hang straight under your shoulder
execution: Pull your elbow up and back toward your hip
Keep your chest square to the bench
Squeeze your upper back at the top
Lower slowly to a full stretch
faults: Don't twist your torso to lift the weight
Don't jerk the weight up with momentum
Don't shrug your shoulder toward your ear
Don't let your back round or sag

notes: Pick the dumbbell up from the floor with a flat back, or set it beside the bench before you get into position.
Use a stable bench and keep the supporting hand directly under the shoulder.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

regressions.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
regressions.reason: Chest on an incline bench removes the need to brace the torso.

progressions.name: Three-point dumbbell row
progressions.reason: Only one hand on the bench, so the trunk works harder to stay still.

progressions.name: Bent-over row
progressions.reason: Unsupported, both arms, heavier loads; more lower-back demand.

substitutions.name: Single-arm cable row
substitutions.reason: Same one-arm pull with steady cable tension. Stack load.

substitutions.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
substitutions.reason: Same pull with no torso bracing needed.

substitutions.name: Seated cable row
substitutions.reason: Both arms on a stack; easy to load in small steps.

substitutions.name: Bent-over row
substitutions.reason: Both arms with a bar; more lower-back demand.

guideBrief.cameraNote: Side view at bench height. The working arm and standing leg are the near side, closest to camera. The supporting knee and hand on the bench are the far side, drawn behind. Bench along the floor line.

keyPositions.label: Start
keyPositions.describe: Torso roughly parallel to the floor (about 10–15° above horizontal), back flat, head in line. Far knee and far hand on the bench, hand under the shoulder, knee under the hip. Near foot planted beside the bench with a soft knee. Near arm hanging straight down from the shoulder holding the dumbbell.

keyPositions.label: Halfway
keyPositions.describe: Elbow bent and travelling up and back. Dumbbell rising under the elbow. Torso and support limbs unchanged, no twist.

keyPositions.label: Top
keyPositions.describe: Elbow drawn up and back just past the line of the torso. Dumbbell beside the lower ribs and hip, forearm close to vertical. Shoulder blade pulled back, not shrugged. Chest still square to the bench.

guideBrief.barPath: Dumbbell moves close to vertical, finishing slightly toward the hip in a small arc
emphasise: Elbow leads the pull toward the hip
Torso stays still and square with no twist
Near working arm drawn clearly in front of the far support limbs

sources.title: ACE Exercise Library: Single Arm Row
